scope.summary: Wire the motion timeline: bind StudioMotionTimeline (hsk.studio.motion_timeline@1) as the keyframe-animation primitive that docks a timeline over the document with one track per animated StudioLayer, as a mode of the unified editor (not a separate app or file type). Motion data persists inside the StudioDocument authority (MT-004) and follows the document's history/undo surface (MT-011). Register the studio.prototype.motion.<command>.v<N> commands through MT-007 and route mutations through ledger + authority.
acceptance_criteria: StudioMotionTimeline bound as unified-editor mode; per-layer tracks; ledger + authority + document history
expected_tests: live: motion command emits ledger event + lands in studio_* authority; timeline is a mode of the unified editor with one track per layer; follows document history

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No motion timeline binding; keyframe animation unroutable/unauditable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
